Saved Views is available today for all customers, included in every paid plan at no extra cost. Instead of rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now capture exactly how you like to see your work and return to it instantly. Set up a filtered board for this sprint's blockers, a list sorted by due date, or a calendar grouped by owner, then save it with a name your whole team will recognize.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so there's plenty of room to organize different projects, clients, or workflows without clutter. Views can also be shared with your team, giving everyone the same starting point instead of asking teammates to recreate a setup from scratch. Shared views update automatically as the underlying data changes, so whoever opens them always sees current information.

We built this feature based on feedback from teams juggling multiple projects who wanted a faster way to get back to work, and we hope it makes your daily planning easier.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
